title: Out of Sight, Not Out of Mind: Unveiling Latent Attack in Latent-based Multi-Agent Systems
abstract: arXiv:2605.28214v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Latent-based multi-agent systems replace parts of explicit inter-agent communication with hidden representations, offering a new direction for efficient and flexible agent collaboration. However, moving coordination into latent space may also move attacks beyond the reach of visible-text inspection. In this paper, we study whether latent states can carry attack-associated information that remains effective during clean executions. To examine this question, we introduce a latent attack framework that reactivates attack-induced effects through latent interventions without reusing adversarial text. Extensive experiments show that the resulting latent attacks can substantially degrade task performance in clean executions, especially when applied to inter-agent KV-cache handoffs rather than local hidden states. Further control analyses indicate that this degradation cannot be reduced to arbitrary perturbations or invalid generation.

translated_title: 视而不见，心念未忘：揭示基于潜空间的多智能体系统中的潜伏攻击
translated_abstract: 基于潜空间的多智能体系统用隐藏表示替代了智能体间部分显式通信，为高效灵活的智能体协作提供了新方向。然而，将协调过程移入潜空间也可能使攻击超出可见文本检查的范围。本文研究了潜状态是否能携带攻击相关信息，并在干净执行过程中保持有效性。为探究此问题，我们引入了一种潜伏攻击框架，通过潜干预重新激活攻击诱导效应，而无需复用对抗性文本。大量实验表明，由此产生的潜伏攻击能显著降低干净执行中的任务性能，尤其是在应用于智能体间KV缓存交接而非局部隐藏状态时。进一步的控制分析表明，这种性能下降不能归结为任意扰动或无效生成。
tldr: 本文提出一种潜伏攻击框架，通过潜空间干预（而非对抗文本）重新激活攻击效应，证明基于潜空间的多智能体系统在KV缓存交接处易受潜伏攻击，显著降低任务性能。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a latent attack framework that reactivates attack effects via latent interventions without adversarial text, showing that latent-based multi-agent systems are vulnerable at KV-cache handoffs, significantly degrading task performance.
